prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on your goals, industry, budget and the specific services you need. That said, Kansas City is home to several highly regarded agencies; two of the most notable are Barkley (creative/branding and integrated campaigns) and VML (digital, experience design and large-scale integrated work).

To give you a useful, tailored recommendation, tell me:
- What’s your main objective? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, PR, etc.)
- What services do you need? (strategy, creative, social, paid media, SEO, web/app, video, PR)
- Your industry and target audience
- Monthly/annual budget range
- Timeline and whether you need a one-off project or ongoing retainers

If you prefer, I can also:
- Provide a short list of 3–5 KC agencies matched to your needs with pros/cons
- Draft RFP or interview questions to screen agencies
- Compare estimated costs and expected deliverables

Which would you like to do?
